analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($176.73) vs SMA5 ($215.00)/SMA20 ($217.37)/SMA50 ($238.71): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($264.88)/SMA200 ($271.12): below long-term trends, confirming strong weakness.
· 52-week position (12.5%) + current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.2 → 34.1): entering oversold territory, continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (3.5719 → -0.8115): confirmed bearish crossover and worsening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $179.15): approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($172.35): near current price, potential for further decline if breached.
· Swing resistance ($180.88): potential for short-term bounce if price moves above.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High formed, continuing decline): confirming downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.32x 5-day average): increased volume supports downward move, raising confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): maintaining a wait-and-see approach with potential for further downside.
